title: AI code: who will review it?
description: “AI is making code faster to produce. Who will review it?” on the light register, no logo, over a bright office photo (a laptop on a code-review page and a pull-request tile on the left), the question on the red brush stroke, then three findings from the Linux Foundation in white cards with red pills: 59%, 52% and 1 in 4.
source: The Linux Foundation, Navigating Open Source Software Development in the Generative AI Era (2026). Figures and wording from the brief's reference image (Nov 2026); the pill labels are ours. Background: generated with ElevenLabs (gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, 4:5, 2K), assets/background.jpg.
